requiredNewVersion: Assigned by AWS after approved publication

environment.base: Copy existing PROD v19 environment; preserve all existing entries
constraints: Never log, persist, or put plaintext key in review artifacts
Guard every $LATEST mutation using freshly read RevisionId
Capture and restore original $LATEST configuration after publishing the PROD version
Recheck DEV alias/version/key fingerprint unchanged before and after
Verify promoted immutable PROD version contains the intended distinct key

publishGate: Exact package hash and complete runtime configuration compared before publication; no source rebuild required because DEV v20 and PROD v19 code hashes match
futureDeploymentGate: A valid-size key check alone does not enforce per-environment key separation. Before any promotion compare target key with other-environment keys and the environment release manifest; do not promote a DEV analytics version to PROD.
